recognize_zh: 觸摸抹片中為鬆散分布的中型細胞，核圓且偏位、染色質細顆粒、細胞質嗜鹼性藍色並有核旁淡染區，呈漿細胞樣／漿母細胞樣外觀。
features: Round, often eccentric nuclei with finely granular to slightly coarse chromatin; inconspicuous to small nucleoli
Moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some with paranuclear pale zone (hof)
Many stripped/naked nuclei and cytoplasmic fragments in a bubbly proteinaceous background
Scattered small lymphocytes and degenerated red cells
describe_en: Touch imprint (Romanowsky-type stain) shows a discohesive population of intermediate-sized plasmacytoid cells with round eccentric nuclei, finely granular chromatin, small nucleoli and moderate basophilic cytoplasm, some with a perinuclear clearing. Numerous bare nuclei and cytoplasmic fragments are present owing to fragility of the cells, with a few small lymphocytes in the background. The cytology indicates a monomorphic plasmacytoid neoplasm and, with tissue immunostains, is consistent with EBV-positive plasmacytoma-like PTLD.

ddx.vs: Plasmablasts are larger with more open chromatin and single prominent central nucleoli, while these cells retain plasmacytoid features with small nucleoli.
DLBCL cells lack eccentric nuclei with hofs and show CD20 positivity on tissue sections.
Reactive infiltrates are mixed with many small lymphocytes, neutrophils and histiocytes rather than a monotonous plasmacytoid population.
